stories.title: Isolate every Ralph issue in a deterministic worktree
stories.description: Add deterministic worktree creation, identity validation, scoped ownership locks, and safe lifecycle behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The first and subsequent issue loops use the issue's deterministic sibling worktree
Duplicate issue, branch, or worktree ownership is rejected
Dirty and diverged worktrees are preserved and rejected
stories.notes: Deterministic preparation, runner path enforcement, scoped shared locks, and safety simulations are implemented.

stories.title: Orchestrate independent Ralph loops
stories.description: Add a priority-ordered concurrent orchestrator with explicit dependency and change-scope safety.
acceptanceCriteria: Merged dependencies determine eligibility
Eligible loops are ordered by priority and issue number
Overlapping eligible scopes are refused before launch
Meaningful and periodic status is reported
stories.notes: The manifest orchestrator verifies merged dependencies, sorts eligible work, rejects overlap, launches concurrently, and reports status.

stories.title: Document and simulate the parallel model
stories.description: Update Ralph contracts and add executable focused simulations for concurrency and safety failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Required repository and Ralph documentation describes worktree orchestration
Focused tests prove independent coexistence and requested safe failures
Current main validation commands pass
stories.notes: Repository contracts and focused Node simulations are updated; current main validation commands pass.

stories.title: Report meaningful orchestration status without flooding
stories.description: Add event-driven transition reports plus a rate-limited heartbeat while suppressing unchanged status polls.
acceptanceCriteria: Loop launch, story completion, publication or CI change, blocker, and completion emit status reports
Multiple changes observed in one poll are coalesced into one report
Unchanged polls emit nothing before the heartbeat interval
Long-running unchanged loops emit one rate-limited periodic heartbeat
Focused tests prove meaningful emissions and unchanged-poll suppression
stories.notes: A transition-aware reporter coalesces observed changes, deduplicates repeated terminal events, suppresses unchanged polls, and emits configurable heartbeats.

stories.title: Isolate GitHub identity for concurrent loops
stories.description: Replace shared GitHub CLI active-account switching with verified process-local authentication for the orchestrator and every child runner.
acceptanceCriteria: Ralph automation never calls gh auth switch
The repository owner identity is verified before GitHub operations
Every child runner receives its own environment copy with the owner GH_TOKEN
Standalone runners bind the owner token without changing global GitHub CLI state
Focused concurrency tests prove loops cannot change each other's GitHub identity
stories.notes: The orchestrator and standalone runner resolve and verify the repository-owner credential without global account switching; concurrent fake-GitHub simulations prove process identities remain isolated.
